330:             items: The items to modify.

332:         # We must potentially split the request into multiple smaller requests
333:         # to avoid the server-side max request size limit.
334:         items_gen = iter(items)
335:         ack_ids_gen = (item.ack_id for item in items)
336:         if default_deadline is None:
337:             deadline_seconds_gen = (item.seconds for item in items)
338:         total_chunks = int(math.ceil(len(items) / _ACK_IDS_BATCH_SIZE))
339: 
340:         for _ in range(total_chunks):
341:             ack_reqs_dict = {
342:                 req.ack_id: req
343:                 for req in itertools.islice(items_gen, _ACK_IDS_BATCH_SIZE)
344:             }
345:             # no further work needs to be done for `requests_to_retry`
346:             if default_deadline is None:
347:                 _, requests_to_retry = self._manager.send_unary_modack(
348:                     modify_deadline_ack_ids=itertools.islice(
349:                         ack_ids_gen, _ACK_IDS_BATCH_SIZE
350:                     ),
351:                     modify_deadline_seconds=itertools.islice(
352:                         deadline_seconds_gen, _ACK_IDS_BATCH_SIZE
353:                     ),
354:                     ack_reqs_dict=ack_reqs_dict,
355:                 )
356:             else:
357:                 _, requests_to_retry = self._manager.send_unary_modack(
358:                     modify_deadline_ack_ids=itertools.islice(
359:                         ack_ids_gen, _ACK_IDS_BATCH_SIZE
360:                     ),
361:                     ack_reqs_dict=ack_reqs_dict,
362:                     default_deadline=default_deadline,
363:                 )
364:             assert (
